title: Continuous-Monitoring Candidate Item
description: Normalized output shape every Source Connector (research-harness-template#418) emits, one object per item, before Interest-Inference scoring. This is an internal pipeline contract, not a MIF finding: a candidate only becomes a MIF-conformant artifact once it survives the Editorial Gate and is handed to the Output Router (research-harness-template#423), which persists it via publish-report/publish-blog under schemas/findings.schema.json.

source.description: Connector identifier, e.g. arxiv, openalex, crossref, semantic-scholar, pubmed, biorxiv, gdelt, hn.

id.description: Source-native stable identifier (DOI, arXiv id, GDELT article URL, HN object id, ...).

published.description: ISO-8601 date or date-time; a source that only publishes a date uses YYYY-MM-DD.

raw.description: The source's own record, verbatim (post XML->JSON normalization for feed-based connectors), kept so the Recommendation Engine can cite it precisely (NFR5).
